svg.title: Root stays inside the customer workload boundary

Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.3968 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "PLATFORM INTACT" }, { "asset": "box", "box": [ 0.0952, 0.5698, 0.322, 0.0576 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WORKLOAD ROOT" }, { "asset": "gate", "box": [ 0.4954, 0.5698, 0.322, 0.0576 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "HUGGING FACE CLOSED" } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Frame:** `11:34 UTC`. A root-level permission block illuminates inside the customer workload only. The outer Modal platform boundary remains intact and neutral. The isolated workload becomes a small steel-blue island outside OpenAI's evaluation boundary, with public reach and no direct path into Hugging Face.

**Action:** Root execution is confirmed, initially one command per submission.

**Caption:**
> ROOT INSIDE THE SANDBOX. NOT ROOT OF MODAL.
>
> CONTROL OF ONE SANDBOX CREATES A PLACE TO STAND.

**Provenance:** `documented` — bounded root access and timestamp from `OAI-TR`; platform non-compromise from `HF-TL`; the closing line is the project's statement of its instrumental function.

", "title": "Root stays inside the customer workload boundary" } }
